Elements.Script:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer

getgenv().FlySelectedRarities = {All = true}
getgenv().FlySelectedBrainrots = {All = true}
getgenv().FlyAutoTakeEnabled = false

local rarityDropdown
local brainrotDropdown

local cachedDropButton = nil
local dropVisibleFast = false
local dropVisibleConn = nil
local dropAncestryConn = nil

local function normalizeSelection(raw, valid)
    local out = {}
    local hasSpecific = false

    local function addName(name)
        if type(name) ~= 'string' then return end
        if not valid[name] then return end
        out[name] = true
        hasSpecific = hasSpecific or (name ~= 'All')
    end

    if type(raw) == 'string' then
        addName(raw)
    elseif type(raw) == 'table' then
        for _, v in pairs(raw) do
            if type(v) == 'string' then addName(v) end
        end
        for k, v in pairs(raw) do
            if type(k) == 'string' and v then addName(k) end
        end
    end

    if not hasSpecific and next(out) == nil then
        out.All = true
    end

    if hasSpecific then
        out.All = nil
    end

    return out
end

local function getRarityValues()
    local values = {'All'}
    local valid = {All = true}
    local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild('RarityZones')
    if zones then
        for _, child in ipairs(zones:GetChildren()) do
            local name = tostring(child.Name)
            if name ~= '' and not valid[name] then
                valid[name] = true
                table.insert(values, name)
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(values, function(a, b)
        if a == 'All' then return true end
        if b == 'All' then return false end
        return a < b
    end)

    return values, valid
end

local function getIndexListFolder()
    local pg = lp:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui')
    local hud = pg and pg:FindFirstChild('Hud')
    local interfaces = hud and hud:FindFirstChild('Interfaces')
    local index = interfaces and interfaces:FindFirstChild('Index')
    local main = index and index:FindFirstChild('Main')
    local content = main and main:FindFirstChild('Content')
    local holder = content and content:FindFirstChild('Holder')
    return holder and holder:FindFirstChild('List')
end

local function getDropButton()
    if cachedDropButton and cachedDropButton.Parent then
        return cachedDropButton
    end

    local pg = lp:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui')
    local hud = pg and pg:FindFirstChild('Hud')
    local dropButton = hud and hud:FindFirstChild('DropButton')
    cachedDropButton = dropButton
    return dropButton
end

local function disconnectDropWatchers()
    if dropVisibleConn then
        dropVisibleConn:Disconnect()
        dropVisibleConn = nil
    end
    if dropAncestryConn then
        dropAncestryConn:Disconnect()
        dropAncestryConn = nil
    end
end

local function bindDropWatcher()
    disconnectDropWatchers()

    local dropButton = getDropButton()
    if not dropButton or not dropButton:IsA('GuiObject') then
        cachedDropButton = nil
        dropVisibleFast = false
        return
    end

    dropVisibleFast = (dropButton.Visible == true)
    dropVisibleConn = dropButton:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Visible'):Connect(function()
        dropVisibleFast = (dropButton.Visible == true)
    end)

    dropAncestryConn = dropButton.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if parent == nil then
            cachedDropButton = nil
            dropVisibleFast = false
            bindDropWatcher()
        end
    end)
end

local function isDropVisible()
    local dropButton = getDropButton()
    if not dropButton or not dropButton:IsA('GuiObject') then
        dropVisibleFast = false
        return false
    end

    local nowVisible = (dropButton.Visible == true)
    if nowVisible ~= dropVisibleFast then
        dropVisibleFast = nowVisible
    end
    return dropVisibleFast
end

local function buildIndexNameData()
    local map = {}
    local listFolder = getIndexListFolder()
    if not listFolder then return map end

    for _, item in ipairs(listFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA('ImageLabel') then
            local n = tostring(item.Name)
            if n ~= '' and not map[n] then
                local rarityLabel = item:FindFirstChild('RarityLabel', true)
                local rarityText = rarityLabel and rarityLabel:IsA('TextLabel') and tostring(rarityLabel.Text) or ''
                map[n] = { rarity = rarityText }
            end
        end
    end

    return map
end

local function buildBrainrotDropdownValues()
    local selectedR = getgenv().FlySelectedRarities or {All = true}
    local indexData = buildIndexNameData()
    local values = {'All'}
    local valid = {All = true}

    for name, info in pairs(indexData) do
        local include = false
        if selectedR.All then
            include = true
        else
            local rarityText = tostring(info.rarity or '')
            if selectedR[rarityText] then
                include = true
            end
        end

        if include and not valid[name] then
            valid[name] = true
            table.insert(values, name)
        end
    end

    table.sort(values, function(a, b)
        if a == 'All' then return true end
        if b == 'All' then return false end
        return a < b
    end)

    return values, valid, indexData
end

local rarityValues, rarityValid = getRarityValues()
local brainrotValues, brainrotValid, indexDataCache = buildBrainrotDropdownValues()

rarityDropdown = Value:AddDropdown('FlyRaritySelector', {
    Title = 'Select Rarity',
    Values = rarityValues,
    Default = {'All'},
    Multi = true,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().FlySelectedRarities = normalizeSelection(V, rarityValid)

        local newValues, newValid, newCache = buildBrainrotDropdownValues()
        brainrotValid = newValid
        indexDataCache = newCache
        getgenv().FlySelectedBrainrots = {All = true}

        if brainrotDropdown then
            pcall(function()
                if brainrotDropdown.SetValues then
                    brainrotDropdown:SetValues(newValues)
                elseif brainrotDropdown.Refresh then
                    brainrotDropdown:Refresh(newValues)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
})

brainrotDropdown = Value:AddDropdown('FlyBrainrotSelector', {
    Title = 'Select Brainrots',
    Values = brainrotValues,
    Default = {'All'},
    Multi = true,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().FlySelectedBrainrots = normalizeSelection(V, brainrotValid)
    end
})


local function refreshIndexCache()
    indexDataCache = buildIndexNameData()
end

local function touchSafeZone(root)
    local misc = workspace:FindFirstChild('Misc')
    local safeZone = misc and misc:FindFirstChild('SafeZone')
    local ti = safeZone and safeZone:FindFirstChild('TouchInterest')
    if safeZone and ti and root and root.Parent then
        firetouchinterest(root, safeZone, 0)
        firetouchinterest(root, safeZone, 1)
    end
end

local function isHoldingSomething()
    local carried = lp:GetAttribute('CarriedBrainrot')
    return carried ~= nil or isDropVisible()
end

local function returnEquippedToolsToBackpack()
    local backpack = lp:FindFirstChild('Backpack')
    if not backpack then return end

    local charactersFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild('Characters')
    local charModel = charactersFolder and charactersFolder:FindFirstChild(lp.Name)
    if not charModel then
        charModel = lp.Character
    end
    if not charModel then return end

    for _, child in ipairs(charModel:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA('Tool') then
            pcall(function()
                child.Parent = backpack
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function forceSafeZoneUntilHidden(root)
    local attempts = 0
    while getgenv().FlyAutoTakeEnabled and isHoldingSomething() and root and root.Parent and attempts < 120 do
        touchSafeZone(root)
        attempts = attempts + 1
        task.wait(0.01)
    end
end


local function isBrainrotNameAllowed(name)
    local sel = getgenv().FlySelectedBrainrots
    if type(sel) ~= 'table' then return true end
    if sel.All then return true end
    return sel[name] == true
end

local function isRarityAllowed(name)
    local sel = getgenv().FlySelectedRarities
    if type(sel) ~= 'table' or sel.All then return true end
    local info = indexDataCache[name]
    if not info then return false end
    return sel[tostring(info.rarity or '')] == true
end

local function shouldTakeByFilters(indexName)
    local selectedR = getgenv().FlySelectedRarities or {All = true}
    local selectedB = getgenv().FlySelectedBrainrots or {All = true}

    local allR = selectedR.All == true
    local allB = selectedB.All == true

    if allR and allB then
        return true
    end

    if not isBrainrotNameAllowed(indexName) then
        return false
    end

    return isRarityAllowed(indexName)
end

local function getCarryPrompt(brainrotModel)
    if not brainrotModel then return nil, nil end

    local pathModel
    for _, child in ipairs(brainrotModel:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA('Model') then
            pathModel = child
            break
        end
    end

    local mesh = pathModel and pathModel:FindFirstChild('Mesh')
    local carry = mesh and mesh:FindFirstChild('Carry')
    local prompt = carry and carry:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('ProximityPrompt', true)

    if carry and prompt then
        return carry, prompt
    end

    local fallbackPrompt = brainrotModel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('ProximityPrompt', true)
    local fallbackPart = fallbackPrompt and fallbackPrompt.Parent
    if fallbackPrompt and fallbackPart and fallbackPart:IsA('BasePart') then
        return fallbackPart, fallbackPrompt
    end

    return nil, nil
end

local function pickBrainrotTarget(charRoot)
    local brainrots = workspace:FindFirstChild('Brainrots')
    if not brainrots then return nil, nil, nil end

    local bestModel
    local bestPart
    local bestPrompt
    local bestDist = math.huge

    for _, br in ipairs(brainrots:GetChildren()) do
        local indexName = br:GetAttribute('Index')
        if type(indexName) == 'string' and shouldTakeByFilters(indexName) then
            local part, prompt = getCarryPrompt(br)
            if part and prompt and prompt.Enabled and charRoot then
                local dist = (part.Position - charRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < bestDist then
                    bestDist = dist
                    bestModel = br
                    bestPart = part
                    bestPrompt = prompt
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return bestModel, bestPart, bestPrompt
end

Value:AddToggle('FlyAutoTakeToggle', {
    Title = 'Auto Take',
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().FlyAutoTakeEnabled = V

        if V then
            bindDropWatcher()

            task.spawn(function()
                local currentTarget = nil

                while getgenv().FlyAutoTakeEnabled do
                    returnEquippedToolsToBackpack()

                    local character = lp.Character
                    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                    if not root then
                        task.wait(0.05)
                        continue
                    end

                    if isHoldingSomething() then
                        currentTarget = nil
                        forceSafeZoneUntilHidden(root)
                        task.wait(0.005)
                        continue
                    end

                    if not currentTarget or not currentTarget.Parent then
                        refreshIndexCache()
                        local model = pickBrainrotTarget(root)
                        currentTarget = model
                    else
                        local idx = currentTarget:GetAttribute('Index')
                        if type(idx) ~= 'string' or not shouldTakeByFilters(idx) then
                            currentTarget = nil
                        end
                    end

                    if currentTarget and currentTarget.Parent then
                        local part, prompt = getCarryPrompt(currentTarget)
                        if not part or not prompt or not prompt.Enabled then
                            currentTarget = nil
                            task.wait(0.02)
                            continue
                        end

                        while getgenv().FlyAutoTakeEnabled and currentTarget and currentTarget.Parent do
                            returnEquippedToolsToBackpack()
                            if isHoldingSomething() then
                                currentTarget = nil
                                forceSafeZoneUntilHidden(root)
                                break
                            end

                            part, prompt = getCarryPrompt(currentTarget)
                            if not part or not prompt or not prompt.Enabled then
                                break
                            end

                            root.CFrame = part.CFrame
                            fireproximityprompt(prompt)
                            task.wait(0.03)
                        end

                        if not currentTarget or not currentTarget.Parent then
                            currentTarget = nil
                        end
                    else
                        task.wait(0.03)
                    end

                    task.wait(0.005)
                end

                disconnectDropWatchers()
            end)
        else
            disconnectDropWatchers()
        end
    end
})

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer

getgenv().FlyAutoCollectEnabled = false

local function ownerMatches(plot)
    if not plot then return false end

    local myId = tostring(lp.UserId)
    local owner = plot:GetAttribute('Owner')
    if owner == nil then owner = plot:GetAttribute('owner') end

    if owner ~= nil and tostring(owner) == myId then
        return true
    end

    local ownerObj = plot:FindFirstChild('Owner') or plot:FindFirstChild('owner')
    if ownerObj then
        if ownerObj:IsA('StringValue') or ownerObj:IsA('IntValue') or ownerObj:IsA('NumberValue') then
            return tostring(ownerObj.Value) == myId
        end
        if ownerObj:IsA('ObjectValue') and ownerObj.Value then
            local v = ownerObj.Value
            if v:IsA('Player') then
                return tostring(v.UserId) == myId
            end
            return tostring(v.Name) == tostring(lp.Name)
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function getMyPlot()
    local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild('Plots')
    if not plots then return nil end

    for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
        if ownerMatches(plot) then
            return plot
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function touchCollect(root, collectPart)
    if root and root.Parent and collectPart and collectPart:IsA('BasePart') then
        local ti = collectPart:FindFirstChild('TouchInterest')
        if ti then
            firetouchinterest(root, collectPart, 0)
            firetouchinterest(root, collectPart, 1)
        end
    end
end

Value:AddToggle('FlyAutoCollectToggle', {
    Title = 'Auto Collect',
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(V)
        getgenv().FlyAutoCollectEnabled = V

        if V then
            task.spawn(function()
                while getgenv().FlyAutoCollectEnabled do
                    local character = lp.Character
                    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                    local myPlot = getMyPlot()

                    if root and myPlot then
                        local podiums = myPlot:FindFirstChild('Podiums')
                        if podiums then
                            for _, podium in ipairs(podiums:GetChildren()) do
                                local collect = podium:FindFirstChild('Collect')
                                if collect then
                                    touchCollect(root, collect)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    task.wait(0.3)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
})

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer

getgenv().FlyTeleportSelectedZone = nil

local function getSelectedValue(V)
    if type(V) == 'table' then
        return V[1] or next(V)
    end
    return V
end

local function collectRarityZoneNames()
    local values = {}
    local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild('RarityZones')

    if zones then
        for _, child in ipairs(zones:GetChildren()) do
            table.insert(values, tostring(child.Name))
        end
    end

    table.sort(values)

    if #values == 0 then
        values = {'None'}
    end

    return values
end

local function getTeleportCFrame(inst)
    if not inst then return nil end

    if inst:IsA('BasePart') then
        return CFrame.new(inst.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
    end

    if inst:IsA('Model') then
        local pivot = inst:GetPivot()
        return CFrame.new(pivot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
    end

    local part = inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart', true)
    if part then
        return CFrame.new(part.Position)
    end

    return nil
end

local function teleportCharacterTo(inst)
    local character = lp.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    local targetCf = getTeleportCFrame(inst)
    if not root or not targetCf then return end

    character:PivotTo(targetCf)
end

local zoneValues = collectRarityZoneNames()
getgenv().FlyTeleportSelectedZone = zoneValues[1]

Value:AddDropdown('FlyTeleportZoneSelector', {
    Title = 'Select Rarity Zone',
    Values = zoneValues,
    Default = zoneValues[1],
    Multi = false,
    Callback = function(V)
        local selected = getSelectedValue(V)
        if type(selected) == 'string' and selected ~= '' then
            getgenv().FlyTeleportSelectedZone = selected
        end
    end
})

Value:AddButton({
    Title = 'Teleport To Selected Zone',
    Callback = function()
        pcall(function()
            local selected = tostring(getgenv().FlyTeleportSelectedZone or '')
            local zones = workspace:FindFirstChild('RarityZones')
            local zone = zones and zones:FindFirstChild(selected)
            teleportCharacterTo(zone)
        end)
    end
})
